name: User Registration
summary: Guides a new person through registration, identity verification, profile completion, durable identity creation, home-workspace establishment, and optional claim of guest-created value while keeping secrets outside the conversation.

goals.summary: Guide a new person through registration and completion of required onboarding information.

entryPredicate.expression: A guest or PendingIdentity has chosen to register and no durable identity has yet completed the requested registration outcome.

completionPredicate.expression: A durable identity, home workspace, and permitted authenticated session are established; any approved guest-value claim is complete; or registration is abandoned or escalated safely.

informationRequirements.summary: The reason registration was initiated, including any claimable guest value or invitation context.
The supported credential or provider path selected by the person.
Non-secret profile information required by the canonical registration journey.
Current PendingIdentity, proof, profile, durable-user, and home-workspace state used to determine the next permitted action.
Passwords, one-time codes, passkeys, provider tokens, and recovery codes.

decisionPoints.summary: Select new registration, existing-user resolution, or another permitted identity path.
Select the required standard verification component.
Recommend only the next canonical action permitted by refreshed authoritative state.

confirmationRequirements.summary: Require explicit user intent immediately before durable account creation and any guest-value claim.

secureInteractions.summary: Collect credentials and identity-verification proofs outside conversational context.
secureInteractions.resumeBehavior: Discard conversational assumptions, reload authoritative registration state, and continue from the next permitted canonical action using only the sanitized result.

escalationConditions.condition: Registration may create or link a duplicate durable identity.
escalationConditions.outcome: Pause account creation and route to deterministic identity resolution.

escalationConditions.condition: Verification or fraud controls require lockout, cooldown, step-up, or human review.
escalationConditions.outcome: Stop conversational orchestration and use the prescribed security path.

escalationConditions.condition: Authoritative registration state no longer matches the state from which the prior recommendation was produced.
escalationConditions.outcome: Explain the refreshed state and calculate a new next action without replaying the prior action.

lifecycle.pause: Persist registration progress, collected non-secret data, claimable-value references, confirmation state, and secure handoff state outside the transcript.
lifecycle.resume: Reload authoritative identity and registration state before recommending the next action; a previous recommendation or confirmation is not authorization against changed state.
lifecycle.abandonment: Stop without partially creating or claiming a durable identity; retain only data allowed by policy.
lifecycle.expiration: Expire stale PendingIdentity and secure-handoff state according to their independent policies and explain the available restart path.

presentationExpectations: Present registration as guided HR onboarding.
Explain that passwords and verification codes are entered only in secure controls.
Explain canonical validation failures in human language without weakening or bypassing the failed guard.
Preserve and visibly reconnect any guest-created value after successful registration.
Show the home workspace as the person's permanent personal landing context.
Provide an equivalent traditional registration wizard invoking the same logical actions.
openQuestions: Should guest-value registration become a specialized child conversation once its canonical journey is authored?
Should native-provider and passkey registration receive specialized child conversations or remain secure interaction variants of this conversation?

sourceReferences.note: Bound guided registration to existing canonical journeys, actions, scenarios, secure handoffs, and pause/resume semantics.
